overview.script:
"""Sequential fixed-grid intake only; no detector, labels, or tuning."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
import cv2,numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageOps,ImageDraw
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=Path.cwd()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre=json.loads((out/'preflight.json').read_text());reports=[]
for meta in pre['videos']:
 p=root/meta['path'];assert sha(p)==meta['sha256']
 stem=p.stem;folder=out/stem;folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 targets=set(int(i) for i in np.linspace(0,meta['reported_frame_count']-1,9).round())
 cap=cv2.VideoCapture(str(p));i=0;frames=[];tiles=[]
 while True:
  ok,bgr=cap.read()
  if not ok:break
  if i in targets:
   target=folder/f'f{i:06d}.png';assert cv2.imwrite(str(target),bgr)
   record=dict(frame_index=i,nominal_time_sec=i/meta['fps'],decoder_pos_msec=cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC),shape=list(bgr.shape),path=str(target.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(target))
   frames.append(record)
   rgb=Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(bgr,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB));thumb=ImageOps.contain(rgb,(480,270))
   tile=Image.new('RGB',(480,300),'#181818');tile.paste(thumb,((480-thumb.width)//2,30+(270-thumb.height)//2))
   ImageDraw.Draw(tile).text((10,8),f'{i/meta["fps"]:.3f} s / frame {i}',fill='white');tiles.append(tile)
  i+=1
 cap.release();assert i==meta['reported_frame_count'],(p,i,meta['reported_frame_count']);assert len(frames)==9
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1440,900),'#181818')
 for j,tile in enumerate(tiles):sheet.paste(tile,((j%3)*480,(j//3)*300))
 target=out/f'{stem}-overview.jpg';sheet.save(target,quality=94)
 assert sha(p)==meta['sha256']
 reports.append(dict(**meta,decoded_frame_count=i,frames=frames,overview_path=str(target.relative_to(root)),overview_sha256=sha(target),input_preserved=True))
 print(stem,i,'frames decoded; 9 overview frames saved',flush=True)
report=dict(schema='s11-public-video-intake-contact-v1',preflight_sha256=sha(out/'preflight.json'),runtime=dict(opencv=cv2.__version__,numpy=np.__version__),videos=reports,script=Path(__file__).read_text(),detector_run=False,physical_labels_created=False)
with (out/'contact-record.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')

"""Predetermined quarter-time local context; display crops are not Recipes."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
import cv2
from PIL import Image,ImageOps,ImageDraw
root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre=json.loads((out/'preflight.json').read_text())
boxes={'beer':[200,0,2500,1440],'milk':[760,240,1480,1060],'water':[740,250,1160,1080]}
items=[]
for m in pre['videos']:
 kind=next(k for k in boxes if k in m['path']);n=m['reported_frame_count'];fps=m['fps'];delta=round(.25*fps)
 centers=[round((n-1)*p) for p in [.25,.5,.75]]
 targets=[c+d for c in centers for d in [-delta,0,delta]]
 items.append(dict(path=m['path'],kind=kind,frame_indices=targets,display_crop_xyxy=boxes[kind]))
plan=dict(reason='Inspect pouring geometry, movement context and cropping limitations; quarter-time centers and +/-0.25 playback seconds were permitted before first overview.',items=items,source_sha256={m['path']:m['sha256'] for m in pre['videos']},human_truth=False,detector_run=False)
with (out/'temporal-preflight.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(plan,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
results=[]
for m,item in zip(pre['videos'],items,strict=True):
 p=root/m['path'];assert sha(p)==m['sha256'];cap=cv2.VideoCapture(str(p));targets=set(item['frame_indices']);tiles={};records=[];i=0
 while i<=max(targets):
  ok,bgr=cap.read();assert ok,(p,i)
  if i in targets:
   x0,y0,x1,y1=item['display_crop_xyxy'];crop=bgr[y0:y1,x0:x1]
   path=out/p.stem/f'quarter-f{i:06d}.png';cv2.imwrite(str(path),crop)
   image=Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(crop,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB));thumb=ImageOps.contain(image,(460,440))
   tile=Image.new('RGB',(480,475),'#181818');tile.paste(thumb,((480-thumb.width)//2,30+(440-thumb.height)//2))
   ImageDraw.Draw(tile).text((10,8),f'{i/m["fps"]:.3f} s / f{i}',fill='white');tiles[i]=tile
   records.append(dict(frame_index=i,path=str(path.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(path)))
  i+=1
 cap.release();assert sha(p)==m['sha256']
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1440,1425),'#181818')
 for j,index in enumerate(item['frame_indices']):sheet.paste(tiles[index],(j%3*480,j//3*475))
 path=out/f'{item["kind"]}-quarter-context.jpg';sheet.save(path,quality=94)
 results.append(dict(**item,frames=records,sheet_path=str(path.relative_to(root)),sheet_sha256=sha(path),input_preserved=True))
 print(item['kind'],'quarter views saved',flush=True)
with (out/'temporal-record.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dict(preflight_sha256=sha(out/'temporal-preflight.json'),results=results,script=Path(__file__).read_text()),f,indent=2);f.write('\n')

source_provenance: Pexels asset IDs are filename-derived only; original pages, acquisition timestamps, filming cadence and shared-session independence have not been verified.

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text());sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre=load(out/'preflight.json');contact=load(out/'contact-record.json');temporal=load(out/'temporal-record.json')
assert sha(out/'preflight.json')==contact['preflight_sha256']
assert sha(out/'temporal-preflight.json')==temporal['preflight_sha256']
coverage=[]
for m,v,t in zip(pre['videos'],contact['videos'],temporal['results'],strict=True):
 assert m['path']==v['path']==t['path'];assert sha(root/m['path'])==m['sha256']
 assert v['decoded_frame_count']==m['reported_frame_count']
 for f in v['frames']+t['frames']:assert sha(root/f['path'])==f['sha256']
 assert sha(root/v['overview_path'])==v['overview_sha256'];assert sha(root/t['sheet_path'])==t['sheet_sha256']
 indices=sorted({f['frame_index'] for f in v['frames']+t['frames']})
 coverage.append(dict(path=m['path'],visually_inspected_unique_frame_indices=indices,unique_frame_count=len(indices),inputs_preserved=True))
report=dict(schema='s11-public-video-intake-v1',preflight=pre,overview=contact,temporal=temporal,
 exposure=coverage,total_decoded_frames=sum(v['decoded_frame_count'] for v in contact['videos']),
 total_unique_inspected_frames=sum(v['unique_frame_count'] for v in coverage),
 assessment_scope='Agent visual screening only. No detector output, human truth, recipe, calibration, operating point or field acceptance.',
 source_provenance='Pexels asset IDs are filename-derived only; original pages, acquisition timestamps, filming cadence and shared-session independence have not been verified.',
 disposition='USEFUL_DEVELOPMENT_CONTROLS_NOT_UNTOUCHED_HOLDOUT',
 priority=['water','beer','milk'],scripts={name:(out/name).read_text() for name in ['read_videos.py','read_temporal.py','package_intake.py']},
 local_artifacts={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [out/'preflight.json',out/'contact-record.json',out/'temporal-preflight.json',out/'temporal-record.json']})
p=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-intake.json'
with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('Decoded',report['total_decoded_frames'],'inspected unique',report['total_unique_inspected_frames'],'all pins unchanged')
print(p,p.stat().st_size)
